title: CICC warns against online posts that incite violence amid ASEAN Summit

blocks.text: The Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Council (CICC) has warned the public against posting or sharing online content that promotes or incites violence amid rallies and demonstrations coinciding with the Philippines’ hosting of the ASEAN Summit.
